name: Lough Avoher Hut
owner_or_maintainer: Mountain Meitheal / Wild Nephin National Park
access_notes: Inside Wild Nephin National Park / Nephin Beg range. The park asks visitors to register before an overnight stay; shelters are first come, first served.
notes: OSM spells this 'Lough Aroher Hut' — kept our name as 'Avoher' per known usage; worth confirming which spelling is correct.
